SET_TAKEN_TIP: What you wear is the set «%s».
NOTHING_FITS: Nothing in your bags goes here.
ITEM_LEVEL_TIP: The median of the levels of the items worn, the shirt and the tabard left out: as many items are at it or above as at it or below.
TRAINER_RESET_UNKNOWN_TIP: The game says the price only at the class trainer: talk to one and it shows here, kept for this character. It grows with each reset and falls again over time.
TRAINER_RESET_TIP: What the class trainer asked for a reset of the talents at your last visit. It grows with each reset and falls again over time.
SETTING_SPEC_ONE: Name of the first spec tab
SETTING_SPEC_TWO: Name of the second spec tab
UNLEARN_ASK: Unlearn «%s»? Its rank and recipes are lost.
SAMPLE: Sample data: the game's own isn't read yet.
SETTING_DURABILITY_TIP: A thin bar under each slot shows how worn its item is, red below a quarter.
SETTING_CLASS_BUILD_TIP: The build whose stat weights rate items before the character's first talent point: the upgrade arrows, the tooltips' percent and the order of the main stats. Shared by the profile's characters of this class. Weights by Pawn Forever.
SETTING_PICKED_BUILD_TIP: This character's build for the talent set: by default the tree with the most points spent; pick one to keep it whatever the talents.
SETTING_SLOT_SIZE_TIP: How large the paper doll's slots are. «Sharpest» is the largest your screen draws an icon at without blurring it.
CRIT_WEAPON: A critical strike deals 100%% more damage.
CRIT_SPELL: A critical effect makes a spell's damage and healing 50%% greater. Most periodic effects can be critical too.
EXPERTISE_TIP: Lowers the chance a target dodges your melee attacks, and past that the chance it parries them. Below: their chances at your expertise.
LANDS_TIP: The chance an ability is neither a miss nor a dodge, from behind, where nothing is parried. Below: what your swings come to from the front, slice by slice of the one roll that settles each; a weapon in each hand misses more with them. A glancing or a blocked blow lands at reduced damage; only a blow from the front is blocked.
LANDS_RANGED_TIP: The chance a shot is neither a miss nor a dodge. Below: what your shots come to, slice by slice of the one roll that settles each.
LANDS_SPELL_TIP: The chance a spell doesn't miss. Below: what your spells come to: a miss, then a crit of what lands. Partial resists aren't counted.
DODGE_MARK: At %s expertise, the target doesn't dodge.
PARRY_MARK: At %s expertise, the target doesn't parry.
HIT_CAP_DUAL: A weapon in each hand, plain swings
ESTIMATED: ≈ Estimated from the gear, the base as your own characters of this class, race and level showed it
NOT_ESTIMATED: ≈ None of your characters has been this class, race and level: only what the gear gives
